title: The People Next Door
sentences: A new family moved into the flat next to mine.
They have two young children and a small dog.
The children are noisy in the morning, but I do not mind.
The mother knocked on my door last Saturday.
She wanted to know where the nearest post office is.
I walked with her and showed her the way.
Now we say hello when we meet on the stairs.
Last week she gave me some soup she had made.
It is nice to know the people who live near you.
My old neighbours never spoke to me at all.
